slot: Korch picks 13th (last) in every odd round and 1st in every even round; the keeper round also runs in draft order, so with no keeper the first three picks are back-to-back (keeper-round #13, R1 #13, R2 #14). Later pairs: 39/40, 65/66, 91/92, 117/118, 143/144, 169/170.
keeper_reasoning: No keeper wins in the simulation (+2.5 pts vs keeping the Avalanche or Guyana, +4.7 vs Indiana). Keeping uses the keeper-round pick on a player you could replace later; not keeping turns it into a free pick at #13, right before your R1/R2 turn.
NHL is flat: Hurricanes, Panthers, Golden Knights, Wild and Stars all sit at 11.1-11.2 EV and last to about R5, so the Avalanche (13.8) is worth only ~2.6 over what you get later.
Guyana is the #1 Country (12.4) but Country is drafted late (median R10), so you can usually get Guyana or Sudan by R2-R4 anyway.
What usually falls to #13 in the keeper round: Texas (NCAAF #2, 16.2, unowned) if Georgia/Ohio State/Notre Dame are kept; otherwise a top Musician (Langley/Dean/Mars).
value_picks: #1/#2 NASCAR (14.5 / 12.5). Nobody drafted NASCAR before pick 63 last year; in the sim Larson is still there at your R1/R3 turn most of the time.
